title: refactor(lodash): add documentation for isFiniteNumber
body:
This adds documentation for our `isFiniteNumber` util function. This is a polyfill recommended by MDN and we don't test it.

See context: https://github.com/algolia/instantsearch.js/pull/3709#pullrequestreview-229522303.
